metadata.title: feat(tests): Add RBAC + multi-transport MCP protocol E2E tests
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add **40 new E2E tests** covering RBAC visibility, token scope enforcement, SSE transport, per-server MCP endpoints, and security deny paths through the MCP JSON-RPC protocol
- Extract shared MCP test helpers into `tests/e2e/mcp_test_helpers.py` (used by both existing and new tests)
- Add `register_fast_time_sse` docker-compose service for always-available SSE gateway
- Add `make test-mcp-rbac` target

### Test classes (tests/e2e/test_mcp_rbac_transport.py)

| Class | Tests | Coverage |
|-------|-------|----------|
| `TestServerVisibilityViaAPI` | 5 | REST API server visibility per role |
| `TestMcpToolsVisibilityByRole` | 5 | MCP `tools/list` per user role |
| `TestMcpResourcesPromptsByRole` | 4 | MCP `resources/list` + `prompts/list` |
| `TestMcpToolCallByRole` | 6 | Tool execution RBAC enforcement |
| `TestMcpScopedTokenPermissions` | 3 | Token scope containment via MCP |
| `TestMcpSSETransport` | 5 | SSE transport end-to-end |
| `TestMcpPerServerEndpoint` | 4 | `/servers/{UUID}/mcp` scoped access |
| `TestDenyPaths` | 6 | Security invariant deny paths |
| `TestCrossTransportConsistency` | 2 | Cross-transport result consistency |

### Key design decisions

- All user/team/role/token setup via real REST API calls (Playwright `APIRequestContext`), not JWT shortcuts
- Team membership via `POST /teams/{id}/members` (admin direct add) for reliability
- Tests assert actual RBAC behavior: team-scoped roles (developer, viewer) are denied `tools.execute` on the default `/mcp` endpoint because it checks global scope only
- Scoped tokens (`scope.permissions`) are correctly blocked at HTTP middleware when missing `servers.use`
- No changes to application code — all fixes are test expectation corrections

## Test plan

- [x] `make test-mcp-cli` — 22 existing tests pass (no regression)
- [x] `make test-mcp-rbac` — 40 new tests pass
- [x] Idempotent on re-runs (handles 400/409 for duplicate resources)

commits.message:
feat(tests): Add RBAC + multi-transport MCP protocol E2E tests

Add 40 new E2E tests covering multi-user RBAC visibility, token scope
enforcement, SSE transport, per-server MCP endpoints, and security deny
paths through the MCP JSON-RPC protocol via mcpgateway.wrapper.

- Extract shared helpers into tests/e2e/mcp_test_helpers.py
- Add tests/e2e/test_mcp_rbac_transport.py with 9 test classes:
  TestServerVisibilityViaAPI, TestMcpToolsVisibilityByRole,
  TestMcpResourcesPromptsByRole, TestMcpToolCallByRole,
  TestMcpScopedTokenPermissions, TestMcpSSETransport,
  TestMcpPerServerEndpoint, TestDenyPaths, TestCrossTransportConsistency
- Add register_fast_time_sse docker-compose service for SSE gateway
- Add make test-mcp-rbac target
- Refactor test_mcp_cli_protocol.py to import from shared helpers

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(tests): clean up pre-existing SSE gateway by URL before re-registering

The docker-compose stack now pre-registers an SSE gateway at
http://fast_time_server:8080/sse. The E2E RBAC test fixture cleanup
only matched by name, missing the docker-compose gateway and hitting
a GatewayDuplicateConflictError (409) on re-registration.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
